mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the last 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases over 3 months and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the 10-year moving average of the rate, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds its 10-year MA and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last month signals increased economic output, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals increased consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM > 0.5% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting investor confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in the same month, and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a strong economic growth with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ > 2% and FEDFUNDS < 2%, and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
